title: refactor(plugin-auth): drop AuthManager's 12 counted query-options any assertions and ratchet the erasure baseline (#25224)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMjbPDrsigsyqoKsV4WZQMz)_

Part of #25224
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6351993113

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line: dropping a type assertion widens no accept set and no public surface, and a type assertion has no emitted byte. Measured below: `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.mjs`, `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` are byte-identical to base.

**The sweep PR of ruling `6351993113` item 1**, between cut 2 (PR #25307, landed note `6354354210`) and the cut(s) that move the nine methods these sites sit in. It follows the amended claim `6354594310`. #25224 stays open for the later cuts.

`scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json` grandfathered `auth-manager.ts` at 12 engine query-options `any`-erasures. This PR drops all 12 in place and ratchets the baseline down, so the nine methods can later move into new modules without carrying a counted site into a file the baseline does not list. Nothing else changes: +12 / −13 over 2 files.

Branch: `claude/project-thread-lg3wrj`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` `9dc1f42d50` after #25307 merged. It names no issue, so the card relation is this body's first line.

## What changes

1. **`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`**: 12 lines. Each counted closer `} as any);` becomes `});`. Each one closes the options literal (argument 1) of an `engine.findOne`, `engine.find` or `engine.count` call that carries `context: SYSTEM_CTX`. The edit was made from the AST: for each call ESLint reports, the script removed exactly the text ` as any` between the literal's `}` and the call's `);`, and refused any site where those 7 characters were anything else.
2. **`scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json`**: exactly what `pnpm check:query-options-erasure --update` writes. The file's key leaves (one line). This is a `scripts/` ledger, and `scripts/` gate files are `domain:spec`'s by the anchoring exception. **Cross-lane, declared:** the edit is the gate's own prescribed ratchet output, not a gate edit.

⛔ Not in this PR (ruling item 1):

- the 13 `engine.update(…, { context: SYSTEM_CTX } as any)` casts, which the ratchet does not count;
- any `as unknown as EngineQueryOptions` or `const opts: EngineQueryOptions` rewrite;
- any other erasure in the file;
- `eslint.config.mjs` or any `scripts/*.mjs`;
- any method move.

## The twelve sites

Re-located by shape at base `9dc1f42d50`: ESLint's `query-options/no-any-erasure`, run on the file's text with the grandfathering lifted, reports exactly 12, the baseline's count. These are the ruling's twelve sites in the ruling's nine methods; only their line numbers have moved since `49185cdb`.

| method | call (line) | closer line |
|---|---|---|
| `stampIdentitySource` | `engine.findOne` `:8854` · `engine.count` `:8864` | `:8856` · `:8867` |
| `refreshMustChangeCacheIfStale` | `engine.count` `:9007` | `:9009` |
| `refreshOrgMfaCacheIfStale` | `engine.count` `:9035` | `:9037` |
| `resolveUserAuthGates` | `engine.findOne` `:9184` · `engine.findOne` `:9193` | `:9188` · `:9195` |
| `assertPasswordNotReused` | `engine.findOne` `:9374` | `:9378` |
| `recordPasswordHistory` | `engine.findOne` `:9421` | `:9425` |
| `unlockUser` | `engine.findOne` `:9689` · `engine.find` `:9703` | `:9691` · `:9705` |
| `enforceSessionControls` | `engine.findOne` `:9748` | `:9752` |
| `enforceConcurrentCap` | `engine.find` `:9832` | `:9837` |

## Report block (ruling `6351993113` item 2)

Base `9dc1f42d50`, head `32f94b8b70`. Every exit code was captured before any pipe. Builds and suites ran through `os-verify-lock`.

- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (both `tsc` projects and `check:test-typecheck`): **exit 0**, after `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/plugin-auth^...'`.
- **ESLint.** `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` (the root `lint` script's binary and flags): **exit 0**. The file's key is gone, so the rule now lints it at `error`, and it flags nothing.
- **The ratchet.**
  - With the 12 closers dropped and the baseline untouched, `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` exits **1**: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts: baselined file is clean/gone (was 12) — ratchet DOWN: run pnpm check:query-options-erasure --update and commit the baseline.`
  - `pnpm check:query-options-erasure --update` exits 0 (`baseline updated: 50 non-test site(s) in 15 file(s)`), and the baseline diff is that one line.
  - Re-run: **exit 0**, `ratchet holds: 50 unswept non-test site(s) in 15 file(s), none new, and every file measured parsed`, and `baseline key set verified against 9dc1f42: no files added`.
- **The bundle.** `pnpm run build` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`, at base and at head, on the same dependency dists. 18 files in `dist/` on both sides, the same list; 16 of them are byte-identical:

  | file | sha256 at base and at head |
  |---|---|
  | `dist/index.js` | `6f45fdf90839b0de47090a92e75f0309c0baa628ed838956a2522c2fad40f034` |
  | `dist/index.mjs` | `2cb04450a30b102aac0df38ebded7bd138b16968cf01dd65e11214269e27712f` |
  | `dist/index.d.ts` | `4bc04c66f724c79782493249820b1b7d9bff7c826931ce6b362d325af8797891` |
  | `dist/index.d.mts` | `d70d7d8063053de2d39bd0dbae06423bbe0ef1dcecf5130b867c6f4d79a0c8cd` |

  The only files that differ are `index.js.map` and `index.mjs.map`, and in each only the `mappings` key differs (`version`, `sources` and `names` are equal).
  - These maps carry no `sourcesContent`, which `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` enforces. So the cause is not the one the ruling expected (embedded source text). It is the source positions.
  - Decoded, each map holds the same number of segments on both sides (67,009 and 67,083). Exactly 12 differ in each map: one on each of the 12 closer lines, at the same generated position, with a source column 7 lower. That is the width of ` as any`, so it is the `)` after the literal.
- **Tests.** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: base `Test Files 187 passed (187)`, `Tests 3525 passed | 10 skipped (3535)`, VERDICT command-exit 0; head the same counts, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Positive control.** One of the 12 restored (`:8856` back to `} as any);`), nothing else:
  - `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` exits **1**: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts: NEW engine query-options erasure (1 site(s)). … This file is not grandfathered, and the baseline never grows.`
  - The same ESLint command exits **1** at `8854:52` (`query-options/no-any-erasure`).
  - Restored with `git checkout --` afterwards; `git diff HEAD` was empty.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 63 commands for the 2 paths. All 63 ran at `32f94b8b70` after a full `turbo run build`, and all 63 exited 0.
- `--ran`: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 25 changed lines.
- Serial constraints are in the claim. Of the open PRs, only #25309 touches `auth-manager.ts`: an import line and the public-config literal near `:8011`, none of the 12 lines. `git merge-tree` of this branch with #25309's head is clean.

## Changeset

None: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4, as ruling `6351993113` item 1 reads it. The emitted bundle and declarations are byte-identical, so this PR publishes nothing.
